title: Receipt Photos Split Charges
subtitle: Paste one block from the receipt-photo chat and the tracker splits each card charge by its receipt, lists grocery items, and books returns as refunds.
intro: The code is already in your Sheet. The upgrade adds a **Receipts** tab (after Grocery Item Names) and a **Card Last 4 (receipts)** column at the end of Accounts.
**What does not change:** nothing already in Transactions, Import Staging or Grocery Items is touched until you paste a receipt block. A receipt only splits the one charge it matches.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before receipts 2026-11-21`.
Reload the Sheet. Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.33.0`. If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload again.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
steps.done: The report includes "Added tab: Receipts". The Receipts tab is empty.

steps.text: Tell Claude the upgrade is done.
steps.done: Claude fills in **Card Last 4 (receipts)** on Accounts for your debit card and the Elan card, so receipts can name a card by its last 4 digits.

steps.text: In the receipt-photo chat, send the photos. Copy the block it gives you (it starts with `HFT-IMPORT v1 RECEIPT`).

Open **Finance Tracker → Import from Claude (paste)…**, paste the block, and check the preview. (Or paste it at A5 of the **Paste Import** tab and run **Finance Tracker → Import the Paste Import tab**.)
steps.done: The preview lists each receipt with its pieces. A receipt marked CHECK did not add up and will be left out; the others go in.

steps.text: Import it. Then open the **Receipts** tab.
steps.done: Each receipt shows **Matched** with its Bank Charge once its card charge was found (on Import Staging or Transactions), or **Waiting** until the charge posts. The next sync matches the waiting ones.

steps.text: Open **Transactions** and find a matched charge.
steps.done: A receipt with one category just sets that category. One with several is a **Split Parent** with one row per category, adding up exactly to the charge. A return is a Refund in its category.

steps.text: For a grocery receipt, open **Grocery Items**.
steps.done: Every line is there with Source **Receipt photo** and the Bank Charge filled in.

steps.text: On **Receipts**, a red **Check** means no charge was found within 3 weeks, or two charges fit equally well. The Notes say which; split the right charge by hand (**Finance Tracker → Split the selected row…**) or tell Claude.
